problem_statement: The UUID library has no way to compare two UUIDs for equality. A helper is needed that, given two UUIDs, returns 0 when their 16-byte values are identical and a nonzero value otherwise, so callers can test whether two UUIDs represent the same identifier (including after copying one UUID into another).
